sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Đây là lần đầu của tôi answers the traveler question "This is my first time" in friendly introductions and light local conversation. This is for when someone asks whether you have visited before. This is one of the easiest travel small-talk answers to use. Its job is naming the concrete item or problem first so staff can choose the next action. Expect a request to see the item, a direction to another desk, or a practical next step; then use Explore next if the reply creates another small task.
